strongest_supported_science_claim: After freezing the G1 seeds, scenario counts, metamorphic relations, negative families, coverage floors, and existing checker blobs before campaign execution, eight independent hosted shards executed 4,288 counted generated scenarios plus 1,024 accepted full-square support controls. Every closure-eligible generated profile satisfied the same bidirectional W7/W8 crossed-trace and exact-CBTNF refinement square and was independently reconstructed by qualified W5 and W6 from both producer paths; every precommitted metamorphic relation held; every negative mutation failed closed at its designated source, refinement, or downstream evidence boundary; and the exact frozen 62-oracle F0 gate remained green. No discrepancy was observed within the precommitted G1 generated distribution and attack families.
nonclaims: G1 is strong falsification evidence, not a proof that no common-mode bug exists.

Because ordinary generated profiles use cross-consistency rather than a third complete reference interpreter as their trace oracle, a semantically identical bug shared by W7 and W8 could in principle survive; precommitted metamorphic and negative relations reduce but do not eliminate that risk.
G1 does not prove arbitrary native binaries, containers, operating systems, cloud services, or agent stacks refine the MFST profile.
G1 does not add ambient capabilities, concurrency, unbounded nondeterminism, remote attestation, or hardware trust.
Ordered trace fidelity remains a C3 refinement obligation before the explicit K1 set projection and is not added to K1 semantics.
This science anchor does not by itself qualify C3 or create preservation authority.
next_gate: Attack the remaining common-mode risk with an orthogonal bounded reference lane: either an independently specified tiny executable oracle for a deliberately smaller MFST sublanguage or exhaustive small-model enumeration whose expected traces are derived without W7/W8 code, then run W7/W8 crossed replay and W5/W6 reconstruction against those externally derived traces before final qualification.
